newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Bangladesh taka ends steady in a dull session.
newsitem.headline: Bangladesh taka ends steady in a dull session.

text.p: The Bangladesh taka closed mostly steady at 42.5460/5490 to the dollar in interbank trading compared with the previous at 42.5460/5480, dealers said.
The local unit was quoted in a wide range at 42.5450/5500 in early trade in a low-key session, dealers said.
The interbank call money rates closed down at 4.0 percent to 5.0 percent from the previous 5.5-6.0 percent in a liquid market following maturity of treasury bills.
